description: A MIDI clip editor: a scrolling roll with a playable keyboard down its side, a loop brace and a ruler that labels bars, beats and sixteenths as you zoom, and a velocity lane you can drag taller. The transport plays, pauses and stops, loops or plays once through, clicks a metronome and sets the tempo and signature. Draw or select notes, mark a scale and fold onto it, undo and redo, and edit the selection from the Notes menu: split at the playhead, chop, join, legato, reverse, invert, stretch, fit to scale, crescendo and humanize. Drop a MIDI file on it to import one, or export the clip as a .mid file

MIDI tracks hold MIDI clips that draw their notes, play through a synth and open on a piano roll in the clip panel; double-click a MIDI lane for a new clip.
